This is more consistent with late-cycle deterioration or a failed transition than with confirmed re-acceleration, but the evidence is mixed and does not establish distribution or an exit signal. The 24h aggressive-flow sums and current BTC spot imbalances offer counterevidence; ETH’s 4h/2h flow and taker imbalance are negative.
